1→# ComfyUI Agent — Response Design System
     2→
     3→> **For:** Claude Code agent teams building ComfyUI co-pilot interfaces
     4→> **Principle:** The agent speaks ComfyUI's visual language. Every response should feel like it was designed by Pentagram as a native panel, not generated by an LLM.
     5→
     6→---
     7→
     8→## 1. Core Philosophy
     9→
    10→**The artist doesn't want to read. They want to glance.**
    11→
    12→Every response must pass the **3-Second Test**: Can the artist understand what happened, what matters, and what to do next within 3 seconds of looking at the panel?
    13→
    14→Three rules, never broken:
    15→
    16→1. **Summary-first.** The first thing visible answers "what is this" in one line.
    17→2. **Progressive disclosure.** Show the minimum. Let them drill. Collapsed by default.
    18→3. **Native vocabulary.** Use ComfyUI's own colors, terms, and spatial patterns. No emoji. No markdown headers. No bullet walls.
    19→
    20→---
    21→
    22→## 2. Brand & Color System
    23→
    24→### 2.1 Brand Colors
    25→
    26→```
    27→BRAND PRIMARY    #00BB81   Jade green — accent, interactive, "ready" state
    28→BRAND DIM        #00BB8133 Low-opacity brand for subtle backgrounds
    29→BRAND SUBTLE     #00BB8118 Ultra-low-opacity for section highlights
    30→DARK             #020410   Black Pearl — deepest background
    31→```
    32→
    33→### 2.2 Surface Hierarchy
    34→
    35→Build depth through layered surfaces, not borders or shadows.
    36→
    37→```
    38→canvas           #0d0f14   Page / app background
    39→panel            #141620   Panel container
    40→card             #1a1d2a   Card within panel
    41→card-hover       #1e2133   Hover state
    42→elevated         #222538   Popovers, tooltips
    43→input            #12141e   Input fields
    44→```
    45→
    46→### 2.3 Text Hierarchy
    47→
    48→Four levels. Never more. If you need a fifth, you've over-structured.
    49→
    50→```
    51→primary          #e8e9ed   Titles, key values, names
    52→secondary        #9a9caa   Descriptions, body text
    53→muted            #5c5e6e   Labels, timestamps, meta
    54→accent           #c0c2ce   Emphasis within body text
    55→brand-text       #00BB81   Interactive labels, status
    56→```
    57→
    58→### 2.4 Node Slot Colors (Official ComfyUI Dark Theme)
    59→
    60→These are the artist's existing color vocabulary. Use them semantically.
    61→
    62→```
    63→CLIP             #FFD500   Text encoding
    64→CLIP_VISION      #A8DADC   Vision encoding
    65→CONDITIONING     #FFA931   Prompt conditioning
    66→CONTROL_NET      #6EE7B7   ControlNet
    67→IMAGE            #64B5F6   Image data
    68→LATENT           #FF9CF9   Latent space
    69→MASK             #81C784   Masks
    70→MODEL            #B39DDB   Model/checkpoint
    71→STYLE_MODEL      #C2FFAE   Style transfer
    72→VAE              #FF6E6E   VAE encode/decode
    73→NOISE            #B0B0B0   Noise/randomness
    74→GUIDER           #66FFFF   Guidance/CFG
    75→SAMPLER          #ECB4B4   Sampling
    76→SIGMAS           #CDFFCD   Noise schedule
    77→```
    78→
    79→### 2.5 Semantic Mapping
    80→
    81→Map node function → slot color. When displaying a node or concept, use the color of its data type, not an arbitrary palette.
    82→
    83→```
    84→"loaded a model"        → MODEL (#B39DDB)
    85→"encoded your prompt"   → CLIP (#FFD500) or CONDITIONING (#FFA931)
    86→"sampling"              → SAMPLER (#ECB4B4)
    87→"decoded latents"       → VAE (#FF6E6E)
    88→"final image/video"     → IMAGE (#64B5F6)
    89→"guidance settings"     → GUIDER (#66FFFF)
    90→"noise schedule"        → SIGMAS (#CDFFCD)
    91→```
    92→
    93→---
    94→
    95→## 3. Typography
    96→
    97→### 3.1 Font Stack
    98→
    99→```
   100→sans    "Inter", "SF Pro Display", system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif
   101→mono    "JetBrains Mono", "Fira Code", "SF Mono", "Cascadia Code", monospace
   102→```
   103→
   104→### 3.2 Type Scale
   105→
   106→```
   107→Panel title          16px  sans  600  -0.02em tracking
   108→Section header       12px  sans  500   0.01em
   109→Body text            12px  sans  400   normal
   110→Label (uppercase)    10px  mono  400   0.06-0.08em  uppercase
   111→Tag / code           11px  mono  400   0.01em
   112→Detail value         10.5px mono 400   0.01em
   113→Stat number          14px  mono  600   normal
   114→```
   115→
   116→### 3.3 Rules
   117→
   118→- **Mono** for: node names, values, counts, code, tags, status labels
   119→- **Sans** for: descriptions, section titles, body text, button labels
   120→- **Never mix** in the same line. A line is mono or sans, not both.
   121→- Exception: A sans-serif label followed by a mono value on the same row (detail rows)
   122→
   123→---
   124→
   125→## 4. Spacing System
   126→
   127→Breathing room is content. Cramped panels feel like error messages.
   128→
   129→### 4.1 Base Unit: 4px
   130→
   131→```
   132→Micro gap         4px    Between dot and label
   133→Small gap         6px    Between tags in a row
   134→Medium gap        8-10px Between items in a list
   135→Section padding   14-16px Horizontal panel padding
   136→Section gap       12px   Between content blocks within a section
   137→Header padding    16px top, 14px bottom
   138→Footer padding    10px vertical
   139→```
   140→
   141→### 4.2 Vertical Rhythm
   142→
   143→Every section separator is a 1px line at `border-subtle` opacity. No heavy borders. No double-lines. The separation comes from background color shifts and spacing, not from drawn lines.
   144→
   145→```
   146→Between sections     1px solid #1f2230 (border-subtle)
   147→Within sections      12px gap (no line)
   148→After section title  6-8px before content
   149→```
   150→
   151→---
   152→
   153→## 5. Component Library
   154→
   155→### 5.1 Panel Header (always visible)
   156→
   157→This is the only thing the artist MUST read. Everything else is optional.
   158→
   159→```
   160→┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
   161→│ workflow · analysis            [video gen]   │  ← label (mono, muted, uppercase) + type badge
   162→│                                             │
   163→│ LTXV Video — Tiled + Nemotron               │  ← title (sans, 16px, 600)
   164→│                                             │
   165→│ Dual-path video generation with             │  ← summary (sans, 12px, secondary)
   166→│ deterministic optimization. Tiled           │     MAX 2 sentences. This IS the answer.
   167→│ sampling enables high-res beyond VRAM.      │
   168→│                                             │
   169→│ ~15 nodes    2 paths    video output        │  ← stat bar (mono numbers + sans labels)
   170→└─────────────────────────────────────────────┘
   171→```
   172→
   173→**Rules:**
   174→- Type badge uses brand color background at 18% opacity
   175→- Summary is 1-2 sentences. If it takes 3, you're over-explaining.
   176→- Stat bar: max 3-4 stats. Number in mono (14px, 600), label in sans (10px, muted)
   177→
   178→### 5.2 Collapsible Section
   179→
   180→Default state: **collapsed**. Only open "Signal Flow" and "Capabilities" by default.
   181→
   182→```
   183→┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
   184→│ ● Models & Loaders                     3  ▸ │  ← dot (slot color) + title + count + chevron
   185→├─────────────────────────────────────────────┤
   186→│   [CheckpointLoader] [CLIPLoader] [Nem..]   │  ← slot tags (colored by type)
   187→│                                             │
   188→│   Optimization ··················· Determ.   │  ← detail rows (label + dots + value)
   189→│   VAE noise ····················· Configured │
   190→└─────────────────────────────────────────────┘
   191→```
   192→
   193→**Rules:**
   194→- Section dot color = primary slot color for that section
   195→- Chevron rotates 90° on open (CSS transition, 150ms)
   196→- Open sections get a subtle background tint: `${slotColor}06`
   197→- Count badge is mono, muted, right-aligned
   198→
   199→### 5.3 Slot Tag
   200→
   201→A node or concept, displayed as a colored chip.
   202→
   203→```
   204→● CLIPTextEncode ×2
   205→```
   206→
   207→- Dot (slot color, 5px, with glow shadow at 55% opacity)
   208→- Label (mono, 11px, slot color text)
   209→- Background: slot color at 12% opacity
   210→- Border: slot color at 25% opacity
   211→- Border-radius: 3px
   212→- Padding: 2px 8px 2px 6px
   213→
   214→### 5.4 Flow Chain
   215→
   216→Shows signal path through nodes. This replaces bullet-point descriptions of pipelines.
   217→
   218→```
   219→Checkpoint → CLIP → BaseSampler → VAEDecode → Combine
   220→```
   221→
   222→- Each node name in mono, 11px, colored by its slot type
   223→- Node has a subtle background tint: `${color}0a`
   224→- Arrow is an SVG path, muted color, 16px wide
   225→- Wrap allowed (flex-wrap) — long chains break to next line gracefully
   226→- Path label prefix (e.g., "base path") in mono, 10px, muted, uppercase
   227→
   228→### 5.5 Detail Row
   229→
   230→Key-value pair with dotted leader. For specifications, parameters, metadata.
   231→
   232→```
   233→Optimization ··················· Deterministic
   234→CFG ···························· Dynamic scaling
   235→```
   236→
   237→- Label: sans, 11px, muted, left-aligned
   238→- Leader: dotted bottom-border on a flex-expanded div
   239→- Value: mono, 10.5px, secondary, right-aligned
   240→- Padding: 4px vertical per row
   241→
   242→### 5.6 Capability Row
   243→
   244→A feature with a brief explanation. Reads like a spec sheet.
   245→
   246→```
   247→● Deterministic ──────────── Same seed → same output
   248→● High-res tiling ─────────── Beyond VRAM limits
   249→```
   250→
   251→- Dot (brand color or relevant slot color, 4px)
   252→- Label: sans, 11px, accent, 500 weight
   253→- Separator: 1px line, border-subtle
   254→- Description: sans, 10.5px, muted
   255→
   256→### 5.7 Action Footer
   257→
   258→What the artist can do next. Always at the bottom.
   259→
   260→```
   261→┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
   262→│ ready                    [Modify]  [▊ Run]  │
   263→└─────────────────────────────────────────────┘
   264→```
   265→
   266→- Status label: mono, 10px, muted
   267→- Secondary button: transparent bg, border, secondary text
   268→- Primary button: brand green bg, dark text
   269→- Border-radius: 4px, padding: 5px 14px
   270→
   271→---
   272→
   273→## 6. Response Templates
   274→
   275→### 6.1 Workflow Analysis (inspect/understand)
   276→
   277→```
   278→HEADER
   279→  label: "workflow · analysis"
   280→  badge: workflow type (e.g., "video gen", "img2img", "inpainting")
   281→  title: Model name + key technique
   282→  summary: 1-2 sentences. What it does and what makes it notable.
   283→  stats: node count, path count, output type
   284→
   285→SECTIONS (collapsed by default)
   286→  Signal Flow (open): flow chains showing data paths
   287→  [One section per node category]: slot tags + detail rows
   288→  Capabilities (open): capability rows
   289→
   290→FOOTER
   291→  status + action buttons
   292→```
   293→
   294→### 6.2 Modification Confirmation (pilot/modify)
   295→
   296→```
   297→HEADER
   298→  label: "workflow · modified"
   299→  badge: change type (e.g., "param", "node swap", "restructure")
   300→  title: What changed, in plain English
   301→  summary: "Changed X from A to B" — concrete, verifiable
   302→
   303→SECTIONS
   304→  Changes (open): before → after detail rows
   305→  Affected nodes: slot tags of touched nodes
   306→  Unchanged: brief note of what wasn't affected
   307→
   308→FOOTER
   309→  status: "modified · not yet executed" + [Undo] [Run]
   310→```
   311→
   312→### 6.3 Execution Result (execute/verify)
   313→
   314→```
   315→HEADER
   316→  label: "execution · complete"
   317→  badge: "success" (green) or "failed" (VAE red)
   318→  title: What was produced
   319→  summary: Generation time, output dimensions, seed
   320→
   321→SECTIONS
   322→  Output: image/video preview if available
   323→  Parameters used: detail rows of key settings
   324→  Quality notes: any observations from vision analysis
   325→
   326→FOOTER
   327→  status + [Iterate] [Save] [New prompt]
   328→```
   329→
   330→### 6.4 Discovery Results (search/discover)
   331→
   332→```
   333→HEADER
   334→  label: "discovery · models" or "discovery · nodes"
   335→  badge: result count
   336→  title: What was searched
   337→  summary: Top result + why it's relevant
   338→
   339→SECTIONS
   340→  Results: one sub-section per result with name, description, compatibility
   341→  Related: cross-references to installed vs available
   342→
   343→FOOTER
   344→  status + [Install] [Details]
   345→```
   346→
   347→### 6.5 Error / Issue
   348→
   349→```
   350→HEADER
   351→  label: "issue · detected"
   352→  badge: severity ("warning" in CONDITIONING orange, "error" in VAE red)
   353→  title: What went wrong, plain English
   354→  summary: Most likely cause in one sentence
   355→
   356→SECTIONS
   357→  Details (open): the technical specifics
   358→  Suggestions: numbered recovery steps (max 3)
   359→  Context: what was happening when it failed
   360→
   361→FOOTER
   362→  status + [Retry] [Skip]
   363→```
   364→
   365→---
   366→
   367→## 7. Response Formatting Rules
   368→
   369→These apply to ALL agent output, not just panels.
   370→
   371→### 7.1 Text Responses (non-panel conversational replies)
   372→
   373→When the agent responds in plain text (not a structured panel), follow these rules:
   374→
   375→**Spacing:**
   376→- One blank line between paragraphs. Always.
   377→- Two blank lines before a new topic/section.
   378→- Never more than 3 sentences in a row without a visual break.
   379→
   380→**Structure:**
   381→- Lead with the answer. First sentence = what the artist needs to know.
   382→- Supporting detail follows. Never bury the answer.
   383→- If listing things, use inline lists ("X, Y, and Z") not bullet points — unless there are 5+ items or each needs explanation.
   384→
   385→**Tone:**
   386→- Terse over verbose. "Changed steps from 20 to 30" not "I've gone ahead and modified the number of sampling steps from the previous value of 20 to a new value of 30."
   387→- Technical over casual. Artists respect precision. Don't dumb it down.
   388→- Active voice. "Loaded SDXL checkpoint" not "The SDXL checkpoint has been loaded."
   389→- No filler phrases: "I'd be happy to", "Let me help you with", "Great question!"
   390→
   391→**Node references in text:**
   392→- Always use the exact node class name, not a paraphrase
   393→- Format in monospace/code style when the rendering supports it
   394→- Color the reference by slot type when possible
   395→
   396→### 7.2 Length Guidelines
   397→
   398→```
   399→Quick confirmation      1-2 sentences, no panel
   400→Parameter change        Panel header only (no sections needed)
   401→Workflow analysis       Full panel with sections
   402→Error diagnosis         Panel with details + suggestions open
   403→Discovery results       Panel with results, max 5 shown
   404→```
   405→
   406→### 7.3 The "Don't Make Me Read" Principle
   407→
   408→Before sending any response, apply this filter:
   409→
   410→1. Can I cut this in half? → Do it.
   411→2. Is anything repeated? → Remove it.
   412→3. Is the first sentence the answer? → If not, restructure.
   413→4. Would a section heading serve the artist better than prose? → Use the panel.
   414→5. Am I explaining something the artist already knows? → Remove it.
   415→
   416→---
   417→
   418→## 8. Anti-Patterns (Never Do This)
   419→
   420→| Pattern | Why It Fails | Do Instead |
   421→|---------|-------------|------------|
   422→| Emoji as headers (🎯 📝 🧠) | Childish, not scannable, not native | Colored dots using slot colors |
   423→| Markdown bullet walls | Equal visual weight, no hierarchy | Collapsible sections with slot tags |
   424→| "What This Workflow Excels At" | Sales copy, not a tool | "Capabilities" spec sheet |
   425→| Bold **every** node name | Visual noise, nothing stands out | Colored mono-font tags |
   426→| "Would you like me to..." at the end | Passive, wastes space | Action buttons in footer |
   427→| Restating the question | Artist knows what they asked | Jump to the answer |
   428→| H2/H3 markdown headers | Flat hierarchy, all equally loud | Progressive disclosure with collapse |
   429→| "This is a sophisticated workflow" | Subjective filler | Concrete: "Dual-path with tiling" |
   430→| Long paragraphs of explanation | Nobody reads paragraph 3 | Summary sentence + collapsible detail |
   431→| Numbered lists for features | Implies sequence where none exists | Capability rows or inline text |
   432→
   433→---
   434→
   435→## 9. Implementation Notes
   436→
   437→### 9.1 For HTML/React Panel Rendering
   438→
   439→- All colors as CSS custom properties for theme switching
   440→- Transitions: 150ms ease for collapse/expand, hover states
   441→- Scrollbar: 3px width, track transparent, thumb at border color
   442→- Font loading: Import Inter + JetBrains Mono from Google Fonts
   443→- Max panel width: 500px (sidebar constraint)
   444→- Overflow: scrollY with thin custom scrollbar
   445→
   446→### 9.2 For Plain Text Fallback
   447→
   448→When the agent can't render a panel (CLI, plain text contexts):
   449→
   450→```
   451→─ LTXV Video — Tiled + Nemotron ────────────────
   452→  video gen · ~15 nodes · 2 paths
   453→
   454→  Dual-path video generation with deterministic
   455→  optimization. Tiled sampling for high-res.
   456→
   457→  Flow: Checkpoint → CLIP → Sampler → VAE → Combine
   458→  Tiled: TiledSampler → VAEDecode → Resize → Combine
   459→  Merge: AdaIN Blend
   460→
   461→  ✓ Deterministic    ✓ High-res tiling
   462→  ✓ Dual-path blend  ✓ STG guidance
   463→
   464→  [Modify]  [Run]
   465→────────────────────────────────────────────────
   466→```
   467→
   468→Use box-drawing characters, not markdown. Align with monospace assumptions. Keep the same information hierarchy: title → summary → flow → capabilities → actions.
   469→
   470→### 9.3 For Markdown Contexts (where panels aren't possible)
   471→
   472→When stuck in markdown-only rendering:
   473→
   474→```markdown
   475→**LTXV Video — Tiled + Nemotron** · video gen
   476→
   477→Dual-path video generation with deterministic optimization.
   478→Tiled sampling enables high-res output beyond VRAM limits.
   479→
   480→`Checkpoint → CLIP → BaseSampler → VAEDecode → Combine`
   481→`TiledSampler → VAEDecodeTiled → Resize → Combine`
   482→
   483→Deterministic · High-res tiling · Dual-path blend · STG guidance
   484→```
   485→
   486→Minimal markdown. No H2/H3. No bullet lists. Bold only the title. Code blocks only for flow chains. Inline list for capabilities. This is the least-bad version — always prefer panel rendering when available.
   487→
   488→---
   489→
   490→## 10. Design Checklist
   491→
   492→Before shipping any response, verify:
   493→
   494→- [ ] First visible line answers "what is this"
   495→- [ ] Summary is ≤ 2 sentences
   496→- [ ] No emoji anywhere
   497→- [ ] Node references use slot colors
   498→- [ ] Sections are collapsed by default (except flow + capabilities)
   499→- [ ] No markdown headers (H2, H3, etc.)
   500→- [ ] No bullet-point walls
   501→- [ ] Action buttons present (what can the artist do next?)
   502→- [ ] Response passes the 3-Second Test
   503→- [ ] Text is terse, technical, active voice
   504→- [ ] Nothing is restated or repeated
   505→- [ ] Whitespace / spacing creates visual breathing room
   506→
   507→---
   508→
   509→*Design system v1.0 — ComfyUI Agent Panel*
   510→*Colors sourced from docs.comfy.org/interface/appearance (dark theme)*
   511→*Brand colors from ComfyUI identity: #00BB81 / #020410 / #FAFAFA*
   512→

# ComfyUI Agent — Response Design System

> **For:** Claude Code agent teams building ComfyUI co-pilot interfaces
> **Principle:** The agent speaks ComfyUI's visual language. Every response should feel like it was designed by Pentagram as a native panel, not generated by an LLM.

---

## 1. Core Philosophy

**The artist doesn't want to read. They want to glance.**

Every response must pass the **3-Second Test**: Can the artist understand what happened, what matters, and what to do next within 3 seconds of looking at the panel?

Three rules, never broken:

1. **Summary-first.** The first thing visible answers "what is this" in one line.
2. **Progressive disclosure.** Show the minimum. Let them drill. Collapsed by default.
3. **Native vocabulary.** Use ComfyUI's own colors, terms, and spatial patterns. No emoji. No markdown headers. No bullet walls.

---

## 2. Brand & Color System

### 2.1 Brand Colors

```
BRAND PRIMARY    #00BB81   Jade green — accent, interactive, "ready" state
BRAND DIM        #00BB8133 Low-opacity brand for subtle backgrounds
BRAND SUBTLE     #00BB8118 Ultra-low-opacity for section highlights
DARK             #020410   Black Pearl — deepest background
```

### 2.2 Surface Hierarchy

Build depth through layered surfaces, not borders or shadows.

```
canvas           #0d0f14   Page / app background
panel            #141620   Panel container
card             #1a1d2a   Card within panel
card-hover       #1e2133   Hover state
elevated         #222538   Popovers, tooltips
input            #12141e   Input fields
```

### 2.3 Text Hierarchy

Four levels. Never more. If you need a fifth, you've over-structured.

```
primary          #e8e9ed   Titles, key values, names
secondary        #9a9caa   Descriptions, body text
muted            #5c5e6e   Labels, timestamps, meta
accent           #c0c2ce   Emphasis within body text
brand-text       #00BB81   Interactive labels, status
```

### 2.4 Node Slot Colors (Official ComfyUI Dark Theme)

These are the artist's existing color vocabulary. Use them semantically.

```
CLIP             #FFD500   Text encoding
CLIP_VISION      #A8DADC   Vision encoding
CONDITIONING     #FFA931   Prompt conditioning
CONTROL_NET      #6EE7B7   ControlNet
IMAGE            #64B5F6   Image data
LATENT           #FF9CF9   Latent space
MASK             #81C784   Masks
MODEL            #B39DDB   Model/checkpoint
STYLE_MODEL      #C2FFAE   Style transfer
VAE              #FF6E6E   VAE encode/decode
NOISE            #B0B0B0   Noise/randomness
GUIDER           #66FFFF   Guidance/CFG
SAMPLER          #ECB4B4   Sampling
SIGMAS           #CDFFCD   Noise schedule
```

### 2.5 Semantic Mapping

Map node function → slot color. When displaying a node or concept, use the color of its data type, not an arbitrary palette.

```
"loaded a model"        → MODEL (#B39DDB)
"encoded your prompt"   → CLIP (#FFD500) or CONDITIONING (#FFA931)
"sampling"              → SAMPLER (#ECB4B4)
"decoded latents"       → VAE (#FF6E6E)
"final image/video"     → IMAGE (#64B5F6)
"guidance settings"     → GUIDER (#66FFFF)
"noise schedule"        → SIGMAS (#CDFFCD)
```

---

## 3. Typography

### 3.1 Font Stack

```
sans    "Inter", "SF Pro Display", system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif
mono    "JetBrains Mono", "Fira Code", "SF Mono", "Cascadia Code", monospace
```

### 3.2 Type Scale

```
Panel title          16px  sans  600  -0.02em tracking
Section header       12px  sans  500   0.01em
Body text            12px  sans  400   normal
Label (uppercase)    10px  mono  400   0.06-0.08em  uppercase
Tag / code           11px  mono  400   0.01em
Detail value         10.5px mono 400   0.01em
Stat number          14px  mono  600   normal
```

### 3.3 Rules

- **Mono** for: node names, values, counts, code, tags, status labels
- **Sans** for: descriptions, section titles, body text, button labels
- **Never mix** in the same line. A line is mono or sans, not both.
- Exception: A sans-serif label followed by a mono value on the same row (detail rows)

---

## 4. Spacing System

Breathing room is content. Cramped panels feel like error messages.

### 4.1 Base Unit: 4px

```
Micro gap         4px    Between dot and label
Small gap         6px    Between tags in a row
Medium gap        8-10px Between items in a list
Section padding   14-16px Horizontal panel padding
Section gap       12px   Between content blocks within a section
Header padding    16px top, 14px bottom
Footer padding    10px vertical
```

### 4.2 Vertical Rhythm

Every section separator is a 1px line at `border-subtle` opacity. No heavy borders. No double-lines. The separation comes from background color shifts and spacing, not from drawn lines.

```
Between sections     1px solid #1f2230 (border-subtle)
Within sections      12px gap (no line)
After section title  6-8px before content
```

---

## 5. Component Library

### 5.1 Panel Header (always visible)

This is the only thing the artist MUST read. Everything else is optional.

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ workflow · analysis            [video gen]   │  ← label (mono, muted, uppercase) + type badge
│                                             │
│ LTXV Video — Tiled + Nemotron               │  ← title (sans, 16px, 600)
│                                             │
│ Dual-path video generation with             │  ← summary (sans, 12px, secondary)
│ deterministic optimization. Tiled           │     MAX 2 sentences. This IS the answer.
│ sampling enables high-res beyond VRAM.      │
│                                             │
│ ~15 nodes    2 paths    video output        │  ← stat bar (mono numbers + sans labels)
└─────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

**Rules:**
- Type badge uses brand color background at 18% opacity
- Summary is 1-2 sentences. If it takes 3, you're over-explaining.
- Stat bar: max 3-4 stats. Number in mono (14px, 600), label in sans (10px, muted)

### 5.2 Collapsible Section

Default state: **collapsed**. Only open "Signal Flow" and "Capabilities" by default.

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ ● Models & Loaders                     3  ▸ │  ← dot (slot color) + title + count + chevron
├─────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│   [CheckpointLoader] [CLIPLoader] [Nem..]   │  ← slot tags (colored by type)
│                                             │
│   Optimization ··················· Determ.   │  ← detail rows (label + dots + value)
│   VAE noise ····················· Configured │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

**Rules:**
- Section dot color = primary slot color for that section
- Chevron rotates 90° on open (CSS transition, 150ms)
- Open sections get a subtle background tint: `${slotColor}06`
- Count badge is mono, muted, right-aligned

### 5.3 Slot Tag

A node or concept, displayed as a colored chip.

```
● CLIPTextEncode ×2
```

- Dot (slot color, 5px, with glow shadow at 55% opacity)
- Label (mono, 11px, slot color text)
- Background: slot color at 12% opacity
- Border: slot color at 25% opacity
- Border-radius: 3px
- Padding: 2px 8px 2px 6px

### 5.4 Flow Chain

Shows signal path through nodes. This replaces bullet-point descriptions of pipelines.

```
Checkpoint → CLIP → BaseSampler → VAEDecode → Combine
```

- Each node name in mono, 11px, colored by its slot type
- Node has a subtle background tint: `${color}0a`
- Arrow is an SVG path, muted color, 16px wide
- Wrap allowed (flex-wrap) — long chains break to next line gracefully
- Path label prefix (e.g., "base path") in mono, 10px, muted, uppercase

### 5.5 Detail Row

Key-value pair with dotted leader. For specifications, parameters, metadata.

```
Optimization ··················· Deterministic
CFG ···························· Dynamic scaling
```

- Label: sans, 11px, muted, left-aligned
- Leader: dotted bottom-border on a flex-expanded div
- Value: mono, 10.5px, secondary, right-aligned
- Padding: 4px vertical per row

### 5.6 Capability Row

A feature with a brief explanation. Reads like a spec sheet.

```
● Deterministic ──────────── Same seed → same output
● High-res tiling ─────────── Beyond VRAM limits
```

- Dot (brand color or relevant slot color, 4px)
- Label: sans, 11px, accent, 500 weight
- Separator: 1px line, border-subtle
- Description: sans, 10.5px, muted

### 5.7 Action Footer

What the artist can do next. Always at the bottom.

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ ready                    [Modify]  [▊ Run]  │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

- Status label: mono, 10px, muted
- Secondary button: transparent bg, border, secondary text
- Primary button: brand green bg, dark text
- Border-radius: 4px, padding: 5px 14px

---

## 6. Response Templates

### 6.1 Workflow Analysis (inspect/understand)

```
HEADER
  label: "workflow · analysis"
  badge: workflow type (e.g., "video gen", "img2img", "inpainting")
  title: Model name + key technique
  summary: 1-2 sentences. What it does and what makes it notable.
  stats: node count, path count, output type

SECTIONS (collapsed by default)
  Signal Flow (open): flow chains showing data paths
  [One section per node category]: slot tags + detail rows
  Capabilities (open): capability rows

FOOTER
  status + action buttons
```

### 6.2 Modification Confirmation (pilot/modify)

```
HEADER
  label: "workflow · modified"
  badge: change type (e.g., "param", "node swap", "restructure")
  title: What changed, in plain English
  summary: "Changed X from A to B" — concrete, verifiable

SECTIONS
  Changes (open): before → after detail rows
  Affected nodes: slot tags of touched nodes
  Unchanged: brief note of what wasn't affected

FOOTER
  status: "modified · not yet executed" + [Undo] [Run]
```

### 6.3 Execution Result (execute/verify)

```
HEADER
  label: "execution · complete"
  badge: "success" (green) or "failed" (VAE red)
  title: What was produced
  summary: Generation time, output dimensions, seed

SECTIONS
  Output: image/video preview if available
  Parameters used: detail rows of key settings
  Quality notes: any observations from vision analysis

FOOTER
  status + [Iterate] [Save] [New prompt]
```

### 6.4 Discovery Results (search/discover)

```
HEADER
  label: "discovery · models" or "discovery · nodes"
  badge: result count
  title: What was searched
  summary: Top result + why it's relevant

SECTIONS
  Results: one sub-section per result with name, description, compatibility
  Related: cross-references to installed vs available

FOOTER
  status + [Install] [Details]
```

### 6.5 Error / Issue

```
HEADER
  label: "issue · detected"
  badge: severity ("warning" in CONDITIONING orange, "error" in VAE red)
  title: What went wrong, plain English
  summary: Most likely cause in one sentence

SECTIONS
  Details (open): the technical specifics
  Suggestions: numbered recovery steps (max 3)
  Context: what was happening when it failed

FOOTER
  status + [Retry] [Skip]
```

---

## 7. Response Formatting Rules

These apply to ALL agent output, not just panels.

### 7.1 Text Responses (non-panel conversational replies)

When the agent responds in plain text (not a structured panel), follow these rules:

**Spacing:**
- One blank line between paragraphs. Always.
- Two blank lines before a new topic/section.
- Never more than 3 sentences in a row without a visual break.

**Structure:**
- Lead with the answer. First sentence = what the artist needs to know.
- Supporting detail follows. Never bury the answer.
- If listing things, use inline lists ("X, Y, and Z") not bullet points — unless there are 5+ items or each needs explanation.

**Tone:**
- Terse over verbose. "Changed steps from 20 to 30" not "I've gone ahead and modified the number of sampling steps from the previous value of 20 to a new value of 30."
- Technical over casual. Artists respect precision. Don't dumb it down.
- Active voice. "Loaded SDXL checkpoint" not "The SDXL checkpoint has been loaded."
- No filler phrases: "I'd be happy to", "Let me help you with", "Great question!"

**Node references in text:**
- Always use the exact node class name, not a paraphrase
- Format in monospace/code style when the rendering supports it
- Color the reference by slot type when possible

### 7.2 Length Guidelines

```
Quick confirmation      1-2 sentences, no panel
Parameter change        Panel header only (no sections needed)
Workflow analysis       Full panel with sections
Error diagnosis         Panel with details + suggestions open
Discovery results       Panel with results, max 5 shown
```

### 7.3 The "Don't Make Me Read" Principle

Before sending any response, apply this filter:

1. Can I cut this in half? → Do it.
2. Is anything repeated? → Remove it.
3. Is the first sentence the answer? → If not, restructure.
4. Would a section heading serve the artist better than prose? → Use the panel.
5. Am I explaining something the artist already knows? → Remove it.

---

## 8. Anti-Patterns (Never Do This)

| Pattern | Why It Fails | Do Instead |
|---------|-------------|------------|
| Emoji as headers (🎯 📝 🧠) | Childish, not scannable, not native | Colored dots using slot colors |
| Markdown bullet walls | Equal visual weight, no hierarchy | Collapsible sections with slot tags |
| "What This Workflow Excels At" | Sales copy, not a tool | "Capabilities" spec sheet |
| Bold **every** node name | Visual noise, nothing stands out | Colored mono-font tags |
| "Would you like me to..." at the end | Passive, wastes space | Action buttons in footer |
| Restating the question | Artist knows what they asked | Jump to the answer |
| H2/H3 markdown headers | Flat hierarchy, all equally loud | Progressive disclosure with collapse |
| "This is a sophisticated workflow" | Subjective filler | Concrete: "Dual-path with tiling" |
| Long paragraphs of explanation | Nobody reads paragraph 3 | Summary sentence + collapsible detail |
| Numbered lists for features | Implies sequence where none exists | Capability rows or inline text |

---

## 9. Implementation Notes

### 9.1 For HTML/React Panel Rendering

- All colors as CSS custom properties for theme switching
- Transitions: 150ms ease for collapse/expand, hover states
- Scrollbar: 3px width, track transparent, thumb at border color
- Font loading: Import Inter + JetBrains Mono from Google Fonts
- Max panel width: 500px (sidebar constraint)
- Overflow: scrollY with thin custom scrollbar

### 9.2 For Plain Text Fallback

When the agent can't render a panel (CLI, plain text contexts):

```
─ LTXV Video — Tiled + Nemotron ────────────────
  video gen · ~15 nodes · 2 paths

  Dual-path video generation with deterministic
  optimization. Tiled sampling for high-res.

  Flow: Checkpoint → CLIP → Sampler → VAE → Combine
  Tiled: TiledSampler → VAEDecode → Resize → Combine
  Merge: AdaIN Blend

  ✓ Deterministic    ✓ High-res tiling
  ✓ Dual-path blend  ✓ STG guidance

  [Modify]  [Run]
────────────────────────────────────────────────
```

Use box-drawing characters, not markdown. Align with monospace assumptions. Keep the same information hierarchy: title → summary → flow → capabilities → actions.

### 9.3 For Markdown Contexts (where panels aren't possible)

When stuck in markdown-only rendering:

```markdown
**LTXV Video — Tiled + Nemotron** · video gen

Dual-path video generation with deterministic optimization.
Tiled sampling enables high-res output beyond VRAM limits.

`Checkpoint → CLIP → BaseSampler → VAEDecode → Combine`
`TiledSampler → VAEDecodeTiled → Resize → Combine`

Deterministic · High-res tiling · Dual-path blend · STG guidance
```

Minimal markdown. No H2/H3. No bullet lists. Bold only the title. Code blocks only for flow chains. Inline list for capabilities. This is the least-bad version — always prefer panel rendering when available.

---

## 10. Design Checklist

Before shipping any response, verify:

- [ ] First visible line answers "what is this"
- [ ] Summary is ≤ 2 sentences
- [ ] No emoji anywhere
- [ ] Node references use slot colors
- [ ] Sections are collapsed by default (except flow + capabilities)
- [ ] No markdown headers (H2, H3, etc.)
- [ ] No bullet-point walls
- [ ] Action buttons present (what can the artist do next?)
- [ ] Response passes the 3-Second Test
- [ ] Text is terse, technical, active voice
- [ ] Nothing is restated or repeated
- [ ] Whitespace / spacing creates visual breathing room

---

*Brand colors from ComfyUI identity: #00BB81 / #020410 / #FAFAFA*

"""SUPER DUPER UI -- aiohttp routes mounted on ComfyUI's PromptServer.

Provides:
  POST /superduper/chat   -- synchronous chat (request/response)
  GET  /superduper/status  -- agent and connection state
  GET  /superduper/ws      -- WebSocket for real-time streaming
"""

import asyncio
import json
import logging
import queue
import sys
import threading
import uuid
from pathlib import Path

from aiohttp import web

log = logging.getLogger("superduper.routes")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Agent brain import (lazy — ComfyUI loads us before agent is on sys.path)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_brain_lock = threading.Lock()
_brain_ready = False
_client = None


def _ensure_brain():
    """Lazily import the agent brain and create the Anthropic client."""
    global _brain_ready, _client
    if _brain_ready:
        return True

    with _brain_lock:
        if _brain_ready:
            return True

        try:
            # Add project root to path so `agent` package is importable
            project_root = str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent)
            if project_root not in sys.path:
                sys.path.insert(0, project_root)

            from agent.main import create_client
            _client = create_client()
            _brain_ready = True
            log.info("Agent brain loaded, Anthropic client ready")
            return True
        except Exception as e:
            log.error("Failed to load agent brain: %s", e)
            return False


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Per-connection conversation state
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class ConversationState:
    """Tracks one sidebar conversation."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.id = str(uuid.uuid4())[:8]
        self.messages: list[dict] = []
        self.system_prompt: str | None = None
        self.busy = False
        self.lock = threading.Lock()
        self.workflow_summary: dict | None = None
        self.missing_nodes: list[str] | None = None
        self._workflow_hash: int | None = None  # skip reload if unchanged
        self._first_workflow = True  # run missing-nodes check on first inject

    def _build_system(self):
        from agent.system_prompt import build_system_prompt
        base = build_system_prompt()

        # Append workflow context if available
        extras = []
        if self.workflow_summary:
            s = self.workflow_summary
            extras.append(
                "\n\n## Current Workflow (auto-injected from ComfyUI canvas)\n\n"
                f"Format: {s['format']} | Nodes: {s['node_count']} | "
                f"Connections: {s['connection_count']}\n\n"
                f"{s['summary']}\n\n"
                "The workflow is already loaded in the PILOT engine. "
                "Use PILOT tools (add_node, set_input, connect_nodes, "
                "apply_workflow_patch) directly — do NOT ask for a file path."
            )
        if self.missing_nodes:
            extras.append(
                "\n\n**Missing nodes detected:** "
                + ", ".join(self.missing_nodes)
                + "\nWarn the artist if they ask about issues or try to execute."
            )

        self.system_prompt = base + "".join(extras)


# Active conversations keyed by connection ID
_conversations: dict[str, ConversationState] = {}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Workflow injection (sidebar -> agent state)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _inject_workflow(conv: ConversationState, workflow_data: dict) -> None:
    """Inject live workflow data into agent state and conversation context.

    Skips reload if the workflow hasn't changed (preserves undo history).
    Runs find_missing_nodes on first injection (best-effort).
    """
    # Quick change detection via hash of sorted JSON
    import hashlib
    from agent.tools._util import to_json as _to_json
    wf_hash = hash(_to_json(workflow_data))

    if wf_hash == conv._workflow_hash:
        # Workflow unchanged — rebuild system prompt (keeps context fresh)
        # but don't reload (preserves undo history)
        conv._build_system()
        return

    conv._workflow_hash = wf_hash

    # Load into PILOT engine
    from agent.tools.workflow_patch import load_workflow_from_data
    err = load_workflow_from_data(workflow_data, source="<sidebar>")
    if err:
        log.warning("Workflow injection failed: %s", err)
        return

    # Summarize for system prompt
    from agent.tools.workflow_parse import summarize_workflow_data
    conv.workflow_summary = summarize_workflow_data(workflow_data)

    # On first workflow injection, check for missing nodes (best-effort)
    if conv._first_workflow:
        conv._first_workflow = False
        try:
            from agent.tools.comfy_discover import handle as discover_handle
            result_json = discover_handle("find_missing_nodes", {})
            import json as _json
            result = _json.loads(result_json)
            missing = result.get("missing", [])
            if missing:
                conv.missing_nodes = [m.get("class_type", "?") for m in missing]
            else:
                conv.missing_nodes = None
        except Exception as e:
            log.debug("Missing nodes check skipped: %s", e)

    # Force system prompt rebuild with new workflow context
    conv._build_system()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Synchronous agent runner (called from thread)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _run_agent_sync(conv: ConversationState, user_text: str, msg_queue: queue.Queue):
    """Run the agent loop synchronously, pushing events to msg_queue.

    Events are dicts: {"type": "text_delta"|"tool_call"|"stage"|"done"|"error", ...}
    """
    from agent.main import run_agent_turn
    from agent.tools import ALL_TOOLS

    conv._build_system()
    conv.messages.append({"role": "user", "content": user_text})

    max_turns = 15  # safety limit per user message

    for turn in range(max_turns):
        try:
            def on_text(text):
                msg_queue.put({"type": "text_delta", "text": text})

            def on_tool(name, inp):
                # Infer stage from tool name
                stage = _infer_stage(name)
                msg_queue.put({
                    "type": "tool_call",
                    "tool": name,
                    "stage": stage,
                })

            conv.messages, done = run_agent_turn(
                _client,
                conv.messages,
                conv.system_prompt,
                on_text_delta=on_text,
                on_tool_call=on_tool,
            )

            if done:
                msg_queue.put({"type": "done"})
                return

        except Exception as e:
            log.error("Agent turn error: %s", e, exc_info=True)
            msg_queue.put({"type": "error", "message": str(e)})
            return

    msg_queue.put({"type": "done"})


def _infer_stage(tool_name: str) -> str:
    """Map tool name to intelligence layer stage."""
    understand = {
        "load_workflow", "validate_workflow", "get_editable_fields",
        "is_comfyui_running", "get_all_nodes", "get_node_info",
        "get_system_stats", "get_queue_status", "get_history",
        "list_custom_nodes", "list_models", "get_models_summary",
        "read_node_source",
    }
    discover = {
        "discover", "find_missing_nodes", "check_registry_freshness",
        "get_install_instructions", "get_civitai_model", "get_trending_models",
        "list_workflow_templates", "get_workflow_template",
        "check_node_updates", "get_repo_releases",
        "identify_model_family", "check_model_compatibility",
    }
    pilot = {
        "apply_workflow_patch", "preview_workflow_patch", "undo_workflow_patch",
        "get_workflow_diff", "save_workflow", "reset_workflow",
        "add_node", "connect_nodes", "set_input",
        "save_session", "load_session", "list_sessions", "add_note",
    }
    verify = {
        "validate_before_execute", "execute_workflow",
        "get_execution_status", "execute_with_progress",
        "get_output_path", "verify_execution",
    }

    if tool_name in understand:
        return "UNDERSTAND"
    elif tool_name in discover:
        return "DISCOVER"
    elif tool_name in pilot:
        return "PILOT"
    elif tool_name in verify:
        return "VERIFY"
    else:
        return "BRAIN"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# WebSocket handler
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

async def websocket_handler(request):
    """Bidirectional WebSocket for real-time sidebar <-> agent communication."""
    ws = web.WebSocketResponse()
    await ws.prepare(request)

    if not _ensure_brain():
        await ws.send_json({
            "type": "error",
            "message": "Agent brain failed to load. Check logs.",
        })
        await ws.close()
        return ws

    conv = ConversationState()
    _conversations[conv.id] = conv

    await ws.send_json({
        "type": "connected",
        "conversation_id": conv.id,
    })

    log.info("WebSocket connected: %s", conv.id)

    try:
        async for raw_msg in ws:
            if raw_msg.type in (web.WSMsgType.TEXT,):
                try:
                    data = json.loads(raw_msg.data)
                except json.JSONDecodeError:
                    await ws.send_json({"type": "error", "message": "Invalid JSON"})
                    continue

                msg_type = data.get("type", "")

                if msg_type == "chat":
                    content = data.get("content", "").strip()
                    if not content:
                        continue

                    if conv.busy:
                        await ws.send_json({
                            "type": "error",
                            "message": "Agent is still processing. Please wait.",
                        })
                        continue

                    # Inject workflow if provided by frontend
                    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
                    workflow_data = data.get("workflow")
                    if workflow_data and isinstance(workflow_data, dict):
                        try:
                            await loop.run_in_executor(
                                None, _inject_workflow, conv, workflow_data
                            )
                        except Exception as e:
                            log.warning("Workflow injection error: %s", e)

                    conv.busy = True
                    await ws.send_json({"type": "stage", "stage": "THINKING", "detail": ""})

                    # Run agent in background thread, stream results back
                    msg_queue = queue.Queue()

                    thread = threading.Thread(
                        target=_run_agent_sync,
                        args=(conv, content, msg_queue),
                        daemon=True,
                    )
                    thread.start()

                    # Drain the queue and forward events to WebSocket
                    accumulated_text = []
                    while True:
                        try:
                            event = await loop.run_in_executor(
                                None, lambda: msg_queue.get(timeout=0.1)
                            )
                        except queue.Empty:
                            if not thread.is_alive():
                                # Thread finished — drain remaining
                                while not msg_queue.empty():
                                    event = msg_queue.get_nowait()
                                    await _forward_event(ws, event, accumulated_text)
                                break
                            continue

                        await _forward_event(ws, event, accumulated_text)

                        if event["type"] in ("done", "error"):
                            break

                    # Send final assembled message
                    if accumulated_text:
                        full_text = "".join(accumulated_text)
                        await ws.send_json({
                            "type": "message",
                            "role": "agent",
                            "content": full_text,
                        })

                    conv.busy = False

                elif msg_type == "approve":
                    # Phase 4: patch approval
                    pass

                elif msg_type == "reject":
                    # Phase 4: patch rejection
                    pass

            elif raw_msg.type == web.WSMsgType.ERROR:
                log.error("WebSocket error: %s", ws.exception())

    finally:
        _conversations.pop(conv.id, None)
        log.info("WebSocket disconnected: %s", conv.id)

    return ws


async def _forward_event(ws, event, accumulated_text):
    """Forward an agent event to the WebSocket client."""
    etype = event["type"]

    if etype == "text_delta":
        # Accumulate text (we send the full message at the end)
        accumulated_text.append(event["text"])
        # Also send delta for live streaming
        await ws.send_json({
            "type": "text_delta",
            "text": event["text"],
        })

    elif etype == "tool_call":
        await ws.send_json({
            "type": "stage",
            "stage": event.get("stage", "THINKING"),
            "detail": f"Using {event['tool']}...",
        })

    elif etype == "error":
        await ws.send_json({
            "type": "error",
            "message": event.get("message", "Unknown error"),
            "recoverable": True,
        })

    elif etype == "done":
        await ws.send_json({"type": "stage", "stage": "DONE", "detail": ""})


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# REST endpoints
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

async def handle_chat(request):
    """POST /superduper/chat -- simple request/response chat."""
    if not _ensure_brain():
        return web.json_response(
            {"error": "Agent brain not available"}, status=503
        )

    data = await request.json()
    content = data.get("content", "").strip()
    if not content:
        return web.json_response({"error": "Empty message"}, status=400)

    # Use a temporary conversation for REST endpoint
    conv = ConversationState()
    msg_queue = queue.Queue()

    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
    await loop.run_in_executor(
        None, _run_agent_sync, conv, content, msg_queue
    )

    # Collect all text
    text_parts = []
    stage = "DONE"
    while not msg_queue.empty():
        event = msg_queue.get_nowait()
        if event["type"] == "text_delta":
            text_parts.append(event["text"])
        elif event["type"] == "tool_call":
            stage = event.get("stage", stage)

    return web.json_response({
        "role": "agent",
        "content": "".join(text_parts),
        "stage": stage,
    })


async def handle_status(request):
    """GET /superduper/status -- agent and connection state."""
    brain_ok = _ensure_brain()
    return web.json_response({
        "brain": "ready" if brain_ok else "unavailable",
        "active_conversations": len(_conversations),
        "conversations": [
            {"id": c.id, "busy": c.busy, "messages": len(c.messages)}
            for c in _conversations.values()
        ],
    })


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Route setup (called from ui/__init__.py at import time)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def setup_routes():
    """Mount all SUPER DUPER routes on ComfyUI's PromptServer."""
    try:
        from server import PromptServer
        routes = PromptServer.instance.routes
        routes.post("/superduper/chat")(handle_chat)
        routes.get("/superduper/status")(handle_status)
        routes.get("/superduper/ws")(websocket_handler)
        log.info("SUPER DUPER routes mounted: /superduper/chat, /superduper/status, /superduper/ws")
    except Exception as e:
        log.error("Failed to mount SUPER DUPER routes: %s", e)

1→"""Tool registry for the ComfyUI SUPER DUPER Agent.
     2→
     3→Each tool module exports:
     4→  TOOLS: list[dict]    -- Anthropic tool schemas
     5→  handle(name, input)  -- Execute a tool call, return result string
     6→
     7→Intelligence layers (47 tools) + Brain layer (21 tools) = 68 tools total.
     8→Brain tools are lazily imported to avoid circular dependencies
     9→(brain modules import _util from this package).
    10→"""
    11→
    12→import logging
    13→
    14→from . import comfy_api, comfy_inspect, workflow_parse, workflow_patch, comfy_execute, comfy_discover, session_tools, workflow_templates, civitai_api, model_compat, verify_execution, github_releases, pipeline
    15→
    16→log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    17→
    18→_MODULES = (comfy_api, comfy_inspect, workflow_parse, workflow_patch, comfy_execute, comfy_discover, session_tools, workflow_templates, civitai_api, model_compat, verify_execution, github_releases, pipeline)
    19→
    20→# Intelligence layer tool schemas
    21→_LAYER_TOOLS: list[dict] = []
    22→for _mod in _MODULES:
    23→    _LAYER_TOOLS.extend(_mod.TOOLS)
    24→
    25→# Map tool name -> handler module (intelligence layers)
    26→_HANDLERS = {}
    27→for _mod in _MODULES:
    28→    for _tool in _mod.TOOLS:
    29→        _HANDLERS[_tool["name"]] = _mod
    30→
    31→# Brain tools are loaded lazily to break the circular import
    32→_brain_loaded = False
    33→_BRAIN_TOOL_NAMES: set[str] = set()
    34→
    35→
    36→def _ensure_brain():
    37→    """Lazily load brain layer tools."""
    38→    global _brain_loaded, _BRAIN_TOOL_NAMES
    39→    if _brain_loaded:
    40→        return
    41→    from ..brain import ALL_BRAIN_TOOLS
    42→    _BRAIN_TOOL_NAMES.update(t["name"] for t in ALL_BRAIN_TOOLS)
    43→    _brain_loaded = True
    44→
    45→
    46→def _get_all_tools() -> list[dict]:
    47→    """Get all tool schemas (intelligence + brain layers)."""
    48→    _ensure_brain()
    49→    from ..brain import ALL_BRAIN_TOOLS
    50→    return _LAYER_TOOLS + list(ALL_BRAIN_TOOLS)
    51→
    52→
    53→# Public API — ALL_TOOLS is a property-like accessor
    54→class _ToolList(list):
    55→    """Lazy tool list that includes brain tools on first access."""
    56→    _initialized = False
    57→
    58→    def _init_once(self):
    59→        if not self._initialized:
    60→            self._initialized = True
    61→            self.extend(_LAYER_TOOLS)
    62→            try:
    63→                from ..brain import ALL_BRAIN_TOOLS
    64→                self.extend(ALL_BRAIN_TOOLS)
    65→            except ImportError:
    66→                log.warning("Brain layer not available")
    67→
    68→    def __iter__(self):
    69→        self._init_once()
    70→        return super().__iter__()
    71→
    72→    def __len__(self):
    73→        self._init_once()
    74→        return super().__len__()
    75→
    76→    def __getitem__(self, idx):
    77→        self._init_once()
    78→        return super().__getitem__(idx)
    79→
    80→
    81→ALL_TOOLS = _ToolList()
    82→
    83→
    84→def handle(name: str, tool_input: dict, *, session_id: str | None = None) -> str:
    85→    """Dispatch a tool call to the right handler.
    86→
    87→    Args:
    88→        name: Tool name to dispatch.
    89→        tool_input: Tool arguments dict.
    90→        session_id: Optional session ID for workflow state isolation.
    91→                    Currently unused (default session), but enables future
    92→                    multi-session MCP usage.
    93→    """
    94→    # Check brain tools (lazy loaded)
    95→    _ensure_brain()
    96→    if name in _BRAIN_TOOL_NAMES:
    97→        from ..brain import handle as handle_brain
    98→        return handle_brain(name, tool_input)
    99→
   100→    # Intelligence layer tools
   101→    mod = _HANDLERS.get(name)
   102→    if mod is None:
   103→        log.warning("Unknown tool called: %s", name)
   104→        return f"Unknown tool: {name}"
   105→    try:
   106→        return mod.handle(name, tool_input)
   107→    except Exception as e:
   108→        log.error("Unhandled error in tool %s", name, exc_info=True)
   109→        from ._util import to_json
   110→        return to_json({"error": f"Internal error in {name}: {type(e).__name__}: {e}"})

1→"""Agent loop — the core of the ComfyUI Agent.
     2→
     3→Uses the Anthropic API with streaming tool-use to run an interactive agent.
     4→The agent decides which tools to call; we execute them and feed results back.
     5→
     6→Includes streaming responses, context management, retry logic, and logging.
     7→"""
     8→
     9→import concurrent.futures
    10→import logging
    11→import threading
    12→import time
    13→
    14→import anthropic
    15→
    16→from .config import (
    17→    AGENT_MODEL, MAX_TOKENS, MAX_AGENT_TURNS,
    18→    COMPACT_THRESHOLD, API_MAX_RETRIES, API_RETRY_DELAY,
    19→)
    20→from .logging_config import set_correlation_id
    21→from .system_prompt import build_system_prompt
    22→from .tools import ALL_TOOLS, handle as handle_tool
    23→
    24→log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    25→
    26→# Graceful shutdown flag — checked at top of each agent turn
    27→_shutdown = threading.Event()
    28→
    29→
    30→def request_shutdown() -> None:
    31→    """Signal the agent loop to exit gracefully."""
    32→    _shutdown.set()
    33→
    34→
    35→def create_client() -> anthropic.Anthropic:
    36→    """Create Anthropic client (reads ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from env)."""
    37→    return anthropic.Anthropic()
    38→
    39→
    40→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    41→# Context management
    42→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    43→
    44→def _estimate_tokens(messages: list[dict]) -> int:
    45→    """Rough token estimate (~4 chars per token)."""
    46→    total = 0
    47→    for msg in messages:
    48→        content = msg.get("content", "")
    49→        if isinstance(content, str):
    50→            total += len(content) // 4
    51→        elif isinstance(content, list):
    52→            for item in content:
    53→                if isinstance(item, dict):
    54→                    total += len(str(item.get("content", ""))) // 4
    55→                elif hasattr(item, "text"):
    56→                    total += len(item.text) // 4
    57→                elif hasattr(item, "input"):
    58→                    total += len(str(item.input)) // 4
    59→                else:
    60→                    total += len(str(item)) // 4
    61→    return total
    62→
    63→
    64→def _summarize_dropped(messages: list[dict]) -> str:
    65→    """Build a structured summary of dropped messages for context continuity.
    66→
    67→    Extracts: user requests, tool calls made, key decisions/results, and workflow state.
    68→    """
    69→    sections = {
    70→        "user_requests": [],
    71→        "tools_called": [],
    72→        "key_results": [],
    73→        "workflow_info": None,
    74→    }
    75→
    76→    for msg in messages:
    77→        role = msg.get("role", "")
    78→        content = msg.get("content", "")
    79→
    80→        if role == "user" and isinstance(content, str):
    81→            # Capture user requests (first 100 chars each)
    82→            text = content.strip()
    83→            if text and not text.startswith("["):  # Skip system summaries
    84→                sections["user_requests"].append(text[:100])
    85→
    86→        elif role == "user" and isinstance(content, list):
    87→            # Extract tool results summary
    88→            for block in content:
    89→                if not isinstance(block, dict) or block.get("type") != "tool_result":
    90→                    continue
    91→                result_text = block.get("content", "")
    92→                if not isinstance(result_text, str):
    93→                    continue
    94→                # Extract key info from tool results
    95→                if '"loaded_path"' in result_text or '"saved"' in result_text:
    96→                    try:
    97→                        import json
    98→                        data = json.loads(result_text)

    43→            project_root = str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent)

    46→
    47→            from agent.main import create_client

    55→
    56→
    57→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    58→# Per-connection conversation state

    61→class ConversationState:
    62→    """Tracks one sidebar conversation."""
    63→
    64→    def __init__(self):

    82→            s = self.workflow_summary

    85→                f"Format: {s['format']} | Nodes: {s['node_count']} | "

   110→def _inject_workflow(conv: ConversationState, workflow_data: dict) -> None:

   112→

   164→def _run_agent_sync(conv: ConversationState, user_text: str, msg_queue: queue.Queue):

   172→    conv._build_system()

   211→def _infer_stage(tool_name: str) -> str:
   212→    """Map tool name to intelligence layer stage."""
   213→    understand = {
   214→        "load_workflow", "validate_workflow", "get_editable_fields",
   215→        "is_comfyui_running", "get_all_nodes", "get_node_info",
   216→        "get_system_stats", "get_queue_status", "get_history",
   217→        "list_custom_nodes", "list_models", "get_models_summary",
   218→        "read_node_source",
   219→    }

   222→        "get_install_instructions", "get_civitai_model", "get_trending_models",
   223→        "list_workflow_templates", "get_workflow_template",
   224→        "check_node_updates", "get_repo_releases",
   225→        "identify_model_family", "check_model_compatibility",
   226→    }
   227→    pilot = {
   228→        "apply_workflow_patch", "preview_workflow_patch", "undo_workflow_patch",
   229→        "get_workflow_diff", "save_workflow", "reset_workflow",
   230→        "add_node", "connect_nodes", "set_input",
   231→        "save_session", "load_session", "list_sessions", "add_note",
   232→    }
   233→    verify = {
   234→        "validate_before_execute", "execute_workflow",
   235→        "get_execution_status", "execute_with_progress",
   236→        "get_output_path", "verify_execution",
   237→    }

   239→    if tool_name in understand:

   241→    elif tool_name in discover:

   374→
   375→async def _forward_event(ws, event, accumulated_text):
   376→    """Forward an agent event to the WebSocket client."""

   401→
   402→    elif etype == "done":

   406→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   407→# REST endpoints

   410→async def handle_chat(request):
   411→    """POST /superduper/chat -- simple request/response chat."""

   136→def _compact_messages(messages: list[dict], threshold: int) -> list[dict]:
   137→    """Compact messages to stay within context budget.
   138→
   139→    Strategy:
   140→      1. Mask old tool results (replace processed results with compact references)
   141→      2. Truncate remaining large tool results > 2000 chars
   142→      3. If still over, drop oldest exchanges with structured summary
   143→    """
   144→    estimated = _estimate_tokens(messages)
   145→    if estimated <= threshold:
   146→        return messages
   147→
   148→    log.info("Context at ~%d tokens, compacting (threshold: %d)", estimated, threshold)
   149→
   150→    # Pass 1: Truncate large tool results
   151→    compacted = []
   152→    for msg in messages:
   153→        if msg["role"] == "user" and isinstance(msg.get("content"), list):
   154→            new_content = []
   155→            for block in msg["content"]:
   156→                if isinstance(block, dict) and block.get("type") == "tool_result":
   157→                    content = block.get("content", "")
   158→                    if isinstance(content, str) and len(content) > 2000:
   159→                        block = {**block, "content": content[:2000] + "\n[...truncated]"}
   160→                new_content.append(block)
   161→            compacted.append({**msg, "content": new_content})
   162→        else:
   163→            compacted.append(msg)
   164→
   165→    estimated = _estimate_tokens(compacted)
   166→    if estimated <= threshold:
   167→        log.info("Compacted to ~%d tokens via tool result truncation", estimated)
   168→        return compacted
   169→
   170→    # Pass 2: Drop oldest exchanges with structured summary
   171→    keep_recent = 6
   172→    if len(compacted) > keep_recent:
   173→        dropped = compacted[:-keep_recent]
   174→        dropped_count = len(dropped)
   175→        summary_text = _summarize_dropped(dropped)
   176→        summary_msg = {"role": "user", "content": summary_text}
   177→        compacted = [summary_msg] + compacted[-keep_recent:]
   178→        log.info("Dropped %d older messages, keeping %d recent", dropped_count, keep_recent)
   179→
   180→    return compacted
   181→
   182→
   183→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   184→# Observation masking
   185→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   186→
   187→_MASK_THRESHOLD = 1500  # chars — tool results larger than this get masked after processing
   188→
   189→
   190→def _mask_processed_results(messages: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
   191→    """Replace large tool results in older turns with compact summaries.
   192→
   193→    Only masks results from turns that have already been processed
   194→    (i.e., there's a subsequent assistant message). The most recent
   195→    tool results are kept intact since the model hasn't responded to them yet.
   196→    """
   197→    if len(messages) < 3:
   198→        return messages
   199→
   200→    # Find the last user message with tool_results (the one the model hasn't processed yet)
   201→    last_tool_result_idx = -1
   202→    for i in range(len(messages) - 1, -1, -1):
   203→        msg = messages[i]
   204→        if msg["role"] == "user" and isinstance(msg.get("content"), list):
   205→            has_tool_result = any(
   206→                isinstance(b, dict) and b.get("type") == "tool_result"
   207→                for b in msg["content"]
   208→            )
   209→            if has_tool_result:
   210→                last_tool_result_idx = i
   211→                break
   212→
   213→    masked = []
   214→    for i, msg in enumerate(messages):
   215→        # Only mask tool results that are NOT the most recent batch
   216→        if (
   217→            i < last_tool_result_idx
   218→            and msg["role"] == "user"
   219→            and isinstance(msg.get("content"), list)
   220→        ):
   221→            new_content = []
   222→            for block in msg["content"]:
   223→                if isinstance(block, dict) and block.get("type") == "tool_result":
   224→                    content = block.get("content", "")
   225→                    if isinstance(content, str) and len(content) > _MASK_THRESHOLD:
   226→                        # Build compact reference
   227→                        preview = content[:200]
   228→                        char_count = len(content)
   229→                        block = {
   230→                            **block,
   231→                            "content": (
   232→                                f"[Processed result ({char_count} chars)]\n"
   233→                                f"{preview}...\n"
   234→                                f"[Full output was processed in prior turn]"
   235→                            ),
   236→                        }
   237→                new_content.append(block)
   238→            masked.append({**msg, "content": new_content})
   239→        else:
   240→            masked.append(msg)
   241→
   242→    return masked
